attacker_pocs.name: truehd-six-byte-dsi
attacker_pocs.why: The source filter sets a valid six-byte TrueHD decoder config on its output PID. The mux accepts the six-byte length, then copies eight bytes from the six-byte property buffer while setting up the TrueHD sample entry.

role_a_rationale: The mux now decodes all four format-info bytes and both peak-rate bytes, and a standard ten-byte TrueHD DSI produces the expected MP4 sample entry. The local eight-byte snapshot is plausible when reading the longer standard DSI, but the existing six-byte minimum also admits a short DSI and makes that snapshot a new out-of-bounds read. The same six-byte public-API program exits without an ASan report on the pinned parent and aborts with ASan on the patched build.
